original.value: A clean editorial fashion advertisement poster on a pale powder-blue studio background with a glossy reflective floor. The composition is vertical and minimal, dominated by oversized bold white condensed sans-serif typography in the background reading “OSAKA SIX:” on the top line and “006 REMAINS” below, filling most of the upper half behind the subject. In the top right corner, small white branding text reads “Designed by ARTTEESHOW.” Centered in the lower middle is an oversized forest-green crewneck sweatshirt standing upright like a sculptural object, with soft heavy cotton fabric, dropped shoulders, extra-long sleeves pooled on the floor, and a small black neck label that reads ARTTEESHOW. On the chest of the sweatshirt is a large abstract collage print made from torn paper fragments in beige, tan, black, gray, white, and vivid red, arranged vertically like layered scraps. Leaning against the right side of the giant sweatshirt is a slim female fashion model with long straight black hair, wearing a matching {argument name="sweatshirt color" default="forest green"} sweatshirt and relaxed wide-leg sweatpants with clean white low-top sneakers. She is posed in profile with a calm detached editorial attitude, one hand in her pocket, her body reclining diagonally against the giant garment, legs extended forward; her face is obscured by a soft rectangular blur for an anonymous art-fashion look. The smaller worn sweatshirt has the same abstract torn-paper collage graphic centered on the chest. At the bottom center, add 2 lines of small white copy text: “Made for comfort, worn for confidence.” and “Because life feels better when someone’s carrying the weight of the world.” The image should feel like a premium conceptual streetwear campaign from the early 1990s reimagined as contemporary luxury advertising, with crisp studio lighting, soft shadows, subtle floor reflections, precise product focus, surreal scale contrast between the oversized sweatshirt and the model, and a polished magazine-poster aesthetic.

zh-CN.value: 一个干净、编辑性的时尚广告海报，背景是淡粉蓝色的工作室，带有光泽的反射地板。构图是垂直和简约的，背景由超大号粗体白色压缩无衬线字体主导，顶部一行写着"OSAKA SIX:"，下方是"006 REMAINS"，占据了主体后方的上半部分大部分空间。在右上角，小的白色品牌文字写着"Designed by ARTTEESHOW。"在下方中央，是一件超大号森林绿色圆领卫衣，像雕塑一样直立，柔软厚重的棉质面料，落肩设计，超长袖子垂在地板上，还有一个小的黑色颈部标签，上面写着ARTTEESHOW。在卫衣胸前是一个大型抽象拼贴画，由米色、棕褐色、黑色、灰色、白色和鲜红色的碎纸片组成，垂直排列，像层叠的碎屑。靠着巨型卫衣右侧的是一位苗条的女性时尚模特，留着长长的黑色直发，穿着配套的{argument name="sweatshirt color" default="forest green"}卫衣和宽松的阔腿运动裤，搭配干净的白色低帮运动鞋。她以侧面姿势摆拍，表情平静疏离，具有编辑风格的态度，一只手插在口袋里，身体斜靠在巨型服装上，双腿向前伸展；她的脸被柔和的矩形模糊遮挡，呈现出匿名艺术时尚的外观。较小的磨损卫衣胸前也有相同的抽象碎纸拼贴图案。在底部中央，添加两行小的白色文字："Made for comfort, worn for confidence。" 和 "Because life feels better when someone's carrying the weight of the world。"图像应该感觉像是1990年代初的高端概念街头服饰活动，重新构想为当代奢华广告，具有清晰的工作室照明，柔和的阴影，微妙的地面反射，精确的产品焦点，巨型卫衣和模特之间超现实的尺度对比，以及精致的杂志海报美学。
